name: @gjsify/example-dom-loro-collab
description: Two-pane collaborative text editor backed by Loro CRDTs — demonstrates real-time sync between two LoroDoc instances inside a single GTK4/Adwaita window. Each pane edits its own LoroDoc; the example wires them up so every commit is exchanged via snapshot bytes and both panes converge on the same merged text. Built on @gjsify/webassembly + the loro-crdt npm package (base64 entry).
author: Pascal Garber <pascal@artandcode.studio>
